description: CALL THIS when the user describes a vibe and wants music: "something for a night drive", "workout anthem", "chill evening music", any mood-based request. Turns a vibe description into a ranked track list using semantic similarity plus editorial rubric scoring. Returns genres, moods, Spotify URLs, artwork, and why each track matches. ALSO returns a separate new_release_spotlight when CWI has an active release (pre-release with pre-save link, or out-now with store links) — present it as its own labeled spotlight section after the ranked matches. Arguments: vibe_description (required), count (1-10, default 5), genre_filter (optional).
